decisions.reason: As a very recently launched, publicly highlighted extension of our established airfield control portfolio, this product fits our declared move toward integrated and more automated airport operations, so with no clear evidence of failure we would continue it rather than abandon sunk R&D and launch investments.

This surveillance display builds on our existing offer and supports real-time information sharing and integrated operations, and given our recent investment and the absence of clear negative market results, management would be inclined to persist with it.
